sentences.en: But wait, can I just say, Eric, that like, I think people might be thinking, OK, well, big donors get access to political candidates who then become presidents all the time.
sentences.zh: 等等，我可以插一句吗，埃里克，我觉得人们可能会想，好吧，大捐赠者总是能接触到后来成为总统的政治候选人。

sentences.en: But just to put a point on this, those donors are, number one, donating for a specific issue or to get a specific candidate elected.
sentences.zh: 但要强调一点，这些捐赠者，第一，是为了某个特定议题或为了让某个特定候选人当选而捐款。

sentences.en: It's not like they're writing checks to somebody's personal bank account.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是在给某人的个人银行账户写支票。

sentences.en: And here, people are paying what sounds like a ton of money to get what sounds like explicit access to the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，人们支付了听起来是一大笔钱，以获得听起来是明确接触美国总统的机会。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, this is not a campaign contribution.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，这不是竞选捐款。

sentences.en: This is a payment that benefits financially the president and his family.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔让总统及其家人在经济上受益的款项。

sentences.en: And that's what makes it so unprecedented is, yeah, we live in a democracy where campaign contributions are legal.
sentences.zh: 这就是它如此前所未有的原因，是的，我们生活在一个竞选捐款合法的民主国家。

sentences.en: And if you make a lot of them, you get more access.
sentences.zh: 如果你捐了很多，你就能获得更多的接触机会。

sentences.en: But we don't live in a country where traditionally, if you pay the elected president of the United States money personally, then you can have dinner with him
sentences.zh: 但我们并不生活在一个传统上如果你个人给当选的美国总统付钱，你就可以和他共进晚餐，

sentences.en: and you enrich his family personally.
sentences.zh: 并且你还能让他的家人个人致富的国家。

sentences.en: And so that's the distinction here, is that the president and his family are personally profiting from this.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的区别在于，总统及其家人正在从中个人获利。

sentences.en: But as we continue to look at this and learned more about the meme coin, what we realized is that this was just a small piece of the cryptocurrency efforts that the Trump
sentences.zh: 但当我们继续研究这个问题并更多地了解模因币时，我们意识到这只是特朗普

sentences.en: family was undertaking.
sentences.zh: 家族正在进行的加密货币努力的一小部分。

sentences.en: And in fact, the scale of the self-enrichment was even greater with their second venture that they call World Liberty Financial.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们称之为“世界自由金融”的第二个项目，其自我致富的规模甚至更大。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Tell us about that company.
sentences.zh: 给我们介绍一下那家公司。

sentences.en: World Liberty is effectively a cryptocurrency bank.
sentences.zh: “世界自由”实际上是一家加密货币银行。

sentences.en: This is the Trump family saying, we're going to become the JPMorgan Chase of the cryptocurrency world, and we're going to make a lot of money doing it.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普家族在说，我们要成为加密货币世界的摩根大通，我们要通过它赚很多钱。

sentences.en: So at first, this new business venture is kicked off shortly before the election.
sentences.zh: 所以起初，这个新的商业项目在选举前不久启动。

sentences.en: It's not taken very seriously.
sentences.zh: 它并没有被太当回事。

sentences.en: It's being promoted by three of Trump's sons,
sentences.zh: 它是由特朗普的三个儿子推动的，

sentences.en: Eric Trump, Don Jr., and Barron, who's now becoming a part of the family business ventures.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·特朗普、小唐纳德和巴伦，巴伦现在也开始参与家族的商业投资了。

sentences.en: And then they've got other outside partners that, for the most part, we'd never heard of.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们还有其他外部合作伙伴，其中大部分我们以前从未听说过。

sentences.en: I mean, a guy named Zach Folkman, Chase Hero, who were these serial entrepreneurs that have had a series of business failures.
sentences.zh: 我是说，像扎克·福克曼、蔡斯·赫罗这样的人，他们都是连续创业者，但经历过一系列商业失败。

sentences.en: They sold a colon cleanser.
sentences.zh: 他们卖过结肠清洁剂。

sentences.en: One of them was selling, you know, kind of how to pick up hot girls advice.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人卖的，你知道，是那种如何搭讪火辣女孩的建议。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It wasn't actually called that, was it?
sentences.zh: 那东西不叫这个名字吧？

sentences.en: No, it really was called that.
sentences.zh: 不，它真的就叫这个名字。

sentences.en: It was a website called DateHotterGirls.com.
sentences.zh: 那是一个叫 DateHotterGirls.com 的网站。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then Zach Witkoff, who's the son of Trump's new Middle East envoy, Steve Witkoff, who's a real estate lawyer and a friend of Trump's for years.
sentences.zh: 还有扎克·威特科夫，他是特朗普新任中东特使史蒂夫·威特科夫的儿子，史蒂夫是一位房地产律师，也是特朗普多年的朋友。

sentences.en: And so it's the Trump sons and these other players that we've not heard of before.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是特朗普的儿子们和这些我们以前没听说过的其他参与者。

sentences.en: What exactly does World Liberty Financial do?
sentences.zh: “世界自由金融”到底是做什么的？

sentences.en: They lay out some of these ambitions in something they call the gold paper, which on the title page has this large portrait of Donald Trump with gold paint splashed across it.
sentences.zh: 他们在所谓的“黄金白皮书”中阐述了一些雄心壮志，白皮书的封面上印着一张巨大的唐纳德·特朗普肖像，上面还溅着金色的油漆。

sentences.en: Trump's face is on every single page of this document that details their ambitions.
sentences.zh: 这份详述他们雄心的文件中，每一页都印着特朗普的脸。

sentences.en: And, you know, they start off by just introducing this token that certain types of investors can buy in October of 2024.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们首先介绍了一种代币，特定类型的投资者可以在2024年10月购买。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, Eric, that token, that's separate from the Trump meme coin we've been talking about, right?
sentences.zh: 埃里克，为了明确起见，那个代币和我们一直在谈论的特朗普模因币是分开的，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's very different from the meme coin.
sentences.zh: 它和模因币非常不同。

sentences.en: This is a token that gives buyers a say in the governance of this new financial institution.
sentences.zh: 这是一种让购买者在这一新金融机构的治理中拥有发言权的代币。

sentences.en: And it can't be bought and sold very rapidly.
sentences.zh: 而且它不能被快速买卖。

sentences.en: It has all kinds of rules around it.
sentences.zh: 它周围有各种各样的规则。

sentences.en: But the Trump family from the start was going to own billions of these tokens, more than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普家族从一开始就打算持有数十亿枚这种代币，比任何人都多。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: OK, so what happens when they release this token into the market?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么当他们把这种代币推向市场时发生了什么？

sentences.en: It's actually quite a flop.
sentences.zh: 实际上相当失败。

sentences.en: And they way underperform their target of having $300 million in sales.
sentences.zh: 他们的销售额远低于3亿美元的目标。

sentences.en: It's they only attract a fraction of that total.
sentences.zh: 他们只吸引了总额的一小部分。

sentences.en: But Trump then wins the election.
sentences.zh: 但随后特朗普赢得了选举。

sentences.en: And from the night of the election, the money starts to pour in where suddenly there are people that want to try to influence Trump.
sentences.zh: 从选举之夜开始，资金开始涌入，突然间，有很多人想要尝试影响特朗普。

sentences.en: There are people who see him as a winner and someone that's likely going to have a successful cryptocurrency venture.
sentences.zh: 有些人视他为赢家，认为他很可能会有一个成功的加密货币项目。

sentences.en: And it goes from having a hard time raising money to raising $550 million in token sales.
sentences.zh: 于是，它从融资困难变成了通过代币销售筹集到5.5亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that's a startling number.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个惊人的数字。

sentences.en: And as reporters at the New York Times, it opens up a bunch of questions for us.
sentences.zh: 作为《纽约时报》的记者，这为我们引出了一系列问题。

sentences.en: Who are these people?
sentences.zh: 这些人是谁？

sentences.en: Why are they buying the token?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要买这种代币？

sentences.en: And what types of conflicts of interest is this going to create when President Trump is back in office and appointing the regulators who are going to oversee his own business?
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统重返办公室并任命监管机构来监督他自己的企业时，这会造成什么样的利益冲突？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Eric, before the break, you told us that you had some questions about who some of the investors were in World Liberty Financial and this new token that it had issued.
sentences.zh: 埃里克，休息前你告诉我们，你对“世界自由金融”及其发行的新代币的一些投资者身份存有疑问。

sentences.en: What did you find when you started looking into that question?
sentences.zh: 当你开始调查这个问题时，你发现了什么？

sentences.en: So one thing about cryptocurrency is that these transactions occur on something called the blockchain, which is essentially a public ledger of all transactions.
sentences.zh: 关于加密货币的一点是，这些交易发生在所谓的区块链上，这本质上是所有交易的公共账本。

sentences.en: And so anytime someone was buying the World Liberty token, their wallet, which is a long number, was publicly available to see.
sentences.zh: 所以每当有人购买“世界自由”代币时，他们的钱包（一串长数字）都是公开可见的。

sentences.en: So we could see 85,000 different wallets ultimately that bought $550 million worth of this token.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最终能看到8.5万个不同的钱包购买了价值5.5亿美元的这种代币。

sentences.en: But all you see is a really long number and you don't know who's behind that wallet.
sentences.zh: 但你看到的只是一串很长的数字，你不知道钱包背后是谁。

sentences.en: And so as a team of reporters at the Times, we were like, we need to figure out who some of these buyers are.
sentences.zh: 作为《时报》的记者团队，我们当时想，我们需要弄清楚这些买家到底是谁。

sentences.en: So the first thing we did was we went to a company called Nansen, which is a cryptocurrency analytics company.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做的第一件事是联系了一家叫 Nansen 的公司，这是一家加密货币分析公司。

sentences.en: And we said to the folks at Nansen, can you do an analysis of all of these 85,000 wallets?
sentences.zh: 我们对 Nansen 的人说，你们能对这8.5万个钱包做一个分析吗？

sentences.en: And can you tell us who some of them are?
sentences.zh: 你们能告诉我们其中一些人是谁吗？

sentences.en: And they came back to us with a spreadsheet of a bunch of possible buyers of World Liberty Financial tokens.
sentences.zh: 他们回传给我们一份电子表格，列出了一堆“世界自由金融”代币的潜在买家。

sentences.en: And they were from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他们来自世界各地。

sentences.en: They were from Gibraltar, from Israel, from Asia, Europe and the United States, but they were more foreign than domestic.
sentences.zh: 他们来自直布罗陀、以色列、亚洲、欧洲和美国，但外国买家比国内买家多。

sentences.en: And a lot of them operating out of countries that you pick if you want to not have a lot of financial transparency, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们中的许多人是在那些如果你想避开金融透明度时会选择的国家运营的。

sentences.en: And so we decided we had to actually reach every single one of those companies and individuals to confirm that they
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定必须亲自联系每一家公司和个人，以确认他们

sentences.en: actually were a buyer because maybe there was a mistake in the data analysis.
sentences.zh: 确实是买家，因为数据分析可能存在错误。

sentences.en: It was a very laborious process because a lot of them did not want to be found.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常费力的过程，因为他们中的许多人不想被找到。

sentences.en: And when you found some of these people, did they tell you why they had bought this token?
sentences.zh: 当你找到这些人时，他们有没有告诉你为什么要买这种代币？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: In fact, I mean, one of the things I also did was I went to some cryptocurrency conferences, including one that happened to be in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我做的一件事是参加了一些加密货币会议，包括一场恰好在华盛顿特区举行的会议。

sentences.en: And I had the list with me and
sentences.zh: 我带着那份名单，

sentences.en: I'm walking around and there's this guy right in front of me from TenZor Capital that was on the liSt. And it's like, wow, that's convenient.
sentences.zh: 我走来走去，正好看到前面有一个来自 TenZor Capital 的人，他就在名单上。这真是太巧了。

sentences.en: And so I asked him, here, I've got you on my liSt. I was wondering, why did you decide to buy the Trump token?
sentences.zh: 所以我问他，我名单上有你。我想知道，你为什么决定买特朗普的代币？

sentences.en: And what he said was that he was confident that Trump was going to make a lot of money on this.
sentences.zh: 他说他确信特朗普会靠这个赚大钱。

sentences.en: And if Trump was going to make a lot of money that he wanted to make money to.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普能赚大钱，他也想赚钱。

sentences.en: So that's one group of investors.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一群投资者。

sentences.en: But there's another that we found.
sentences.zh: 但我们还发现了另一群人。

sentences.en: And these are people who are enthusiastic about Trump's plans for crypto, because Trump by this point has announced that he's going to significantly curtail the regulatory reach of
sentences.zh: 这些人对特朗普的加密货币计划充满热情，因为特朗普此时已经宣布，他将大幅削减政府

sentences.en: the government as it comes to crypto.
sentences.zh: 在加密货币方面的监管范围。

sentences.en: And these investors wanted to send a signal to President
sentences.zh: 这些投资者想向特朗普总统发出一个信号：

sentences.en: Trump that we support this effort.
sentences.zh: 我们支持这项努力。

sentences.en: Then we found that there's people who bought the token who previously been investigated themselves.
sentences.zh: 然后我们发现，还有一些买入代币的人自己以前就曾被调查过。

sentences.en: So these are people who'd been charged with breaking federal laws that are buying the Trump token and celebrating the fact that he's going to basically
sentences.zh: 这些人曾被指控违反联邦法律，他们购买特朗普代币并庆祝他基本上将要

sentences.en: restrict the powers of the federal regulators that had gone after them previously.
sentences.zh: 限制那些此前曾追查过他们的联邦监管机构的权力。

sentences.en: Can you give me an example of one of these people that they'd run afoul of regulators before and were sort of excited?
sentences.zh: 你能给我举一个例子吗？就是那些之前曾触犯监管机构，现在感到兴奋的人？

sentences.en: I mean, the best example is Justin's son, who has a company called Tron.
sentences.zh: 最好的例子就是孙宇晨，他拥有一家叫波场（Tron）的公司。

sentences.en: His name sounds sort of familiar.
sentences.zh: 这个名字听起来有点耳熟。

sentences.en: Yeah, Justin's son became a phenomenon when he's the guy that bought at an art auction a banana
sentences.zh: 是的，孙宇晨成了一个现象级人物，他就是那个在艺术拍卖会上买下一根

sentences.en: that had been taped to the wall for millions of dollars and then proceeded to eat the banana as a stunt.
sentences.zh: 用胶带贴在墙上的香蕉，花了数百万美元，然后为了噱头把那根香蕉吃掉的人。

sentences.en: I remember this guy.
sentences.zh: 我记得这个人。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The six million dollar banana.
sentences.zh: 那根六百万美元的香蕉。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He likes being in the limelight.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢成为焦点。

sentences.en: In 2023, he was accused of violating United States securities law, and he was in the midst of a very intense battle to avoid being sanctioned by the
sentences.zh: 2023年，他被指控违反美国证券法，当时他正处于一场非常激烈的斗争中，以避免受到

sentences.en: United States government.
sentences.zh: 美国政府的制裁。

sentences.en: Then Trump is reelected to a second term, and that's when Justin's son decides to commit tens of millions of dollars to World Liberty Financial.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普连任了，就在那时，孙宇晨决定向“世界自由金融”投入数千万美元。

sentences.en: He's purchased 75 million dollars of the token.
sentences.zh: 他购买了7500万美元的代币。

sentences.en: And ultimately, after Trump is elected and appoints new leadership at the Securities and Exchange
sentences.zh: 最终，在特朗普当选并任命了证券交易委员会的新领导层之后，

sentences.en: Commission, the United States government and Justin's son's lawyers agree to put the case on hold.
sentences.zh: 美国政府和孙宇晨的律师同意将此案搁置。

sentences.en: It hasn't yet been dropped, but essentially the investigation has been frozen.
sentences.zh: 虽然还没有撤诉，但本质上调查已经被冻结了。

sentences.en: Sounds like Justin's son effectively bought himself leniency from the SEC.
sentences.zh: 听起来孙宇晨实际上是从美国证券交易委员会那里买到了宽大处理。

sentences.en: I mean, if you look at the sequence of events, that's how it unfolds.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这一系列事件，事情就是这样发展的。

sentences.en: Justin's son is accused of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 孙宇晨被指控有不当行为。

sentences.en: Justin's son, you know, puts up tens of millions of dollars into a Trump family business venture, and then the investigation stops.
sentences.zh: 孙宇晨向特朗普家族的商业项目投入了数千万美元，然后调查就停止了。

sentences.en: Now, World Liberty Financial says that there have been no quid pro quos, no deals made here that if you buy in, we'll get you actions from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 现在，“世界自由金融”表示不存在任何利益交换，没有达成任何交易，即如果你投资，我们就会让联邦政府为你采取行动。

sentences.en: But sequentially, that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 但从时间顺序上看，事情就是这样发生的。

sentences.en: So this company is creating new appearances of conflicts of intereSt. But I'm trying to
sentences.zh: 所以这家公司正在制造新的利益冲突表象。但我试图

sentences.en: understand, what does World Liberty Financial actually do with the money that they raise from the tokens that you're describing?
sentences.zh: 理解，“世界自由金融”到底用你们描述的那些代币筹集到的钱做了什么？

sentences.en: One of the first things that World Liberty Financial does is with this 550 million dollars
